name: es-kairos
description: Native AppKit MCP server that bridges Claude to macOS Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and Apple Mail — list, search, create, update, complete, and delete through Apple's EventKit and Contacts frameworks, plus Mail access via Scripting Bridge: read, search, draft, file, and send. Deletions and every outgoing email are gated by native confirmation dialogs — sending shows the full recipients, subject, and body before anything leaves the Mac.
